incoming.name: Great white shark
incoming.excerpt: More than any documented attack, Steven Spielberg's 1975 film Jaws provided the great white with the image of a "man eater" in the public mind.

incoming.name: Plesiosaur
incoming.excerpt: The plesiosaur is also present in the Japanese Jaws-inspired movie Legend of the Dinosaurs (1983).
